abstract: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation. business_implications_zh: OneRec系列已大规模部署于生产环境，说明该生成式推荐范式具备工业落地可行性。
通过SIGIR 2026挑战赛汇聚研究者，可能加速面向下一代推荐系统的基础模型技术生态建设。
推理式生成推荐若成熟，可提升推荐系统对用户兴趣的解释性和智能化水平。
contributions_zh: 提出并部署了基于语义ID的OneRec/OneRec-V2模型，验证了自回归下一项预测范式在工业推荐系统中的扩展能力。
探索了OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason等将物品语义ID与自然语言统一在表示空间中的系列模型。
提出OneReason：增强物品与语言之间的语义对齐，使用结构化模板监督兴趣推理，并应用强化学习让推理更有利于推荐。
联合SIGIR 2026组织了KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026推理生成式推荐挑战赛，推动该前沿方向研究。

findings_zh: 初步工作发现引入推理CoT并不总是提升推荐性能，因此OneReason重点让推理对推荐更有益。
OneRec/OneRec-V2已广泛部署于生产环境，展示了该范式在工业推荐系统中的扩展潜力。

limitations_zh: 初步研究表明引入自然语言CoT推理可能不改善甚至损害推荐性能，需要额外机制来保障效果。
当前资料未提供具体评测数据集、基线、指标与消融实验结果，难以独立验证OneReason的技术优势。
deep_reading.method_zh: OneReason在OneRec系列基础上，将物品语义ID与自然语言连接在统一表示空间中；通过增强物品与语言的语义对齐、引入基于结构化模板的兴趣推理监督，以及应用先进强化学习技术，使链式推理过程对推荐结果产生正面帮助。
deep_reading.problem_zh: 生成式推荐在LLM浪潮下成为重要方向；基于语义ID的自回归下一项预测范式具有扩展潜力，但引入自然语言链式推理（CoT）并不总能提升推荐性能。

summary_zh: 该挑战赛介绍基于语义ID的OneRec系列与OneReason等模型，探索大语言模型在生成式推荐与自然语言链式推理中的潜力。
title: KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation
